signIn.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

pair.title: Just the two of you
pair.subtitle: One of you starts, the other joins with the code.
pair.shareHint: Share this with your partner. It stops working once they join.
pair.waiting: Waiting for your partner to join.
pair.partnerJoinedHint: Both phones can read everything the two of you write from here on.
pair.partnerAwayHint: It was here a moment ago. Open the app on their phone and it will appear again. The invite code has already been used, so it won't work a second time.

error.invalid_code: That code doesn't match. Check it and try again.
error.couple_full: That code belongs to a pair that is already complete.
error.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.unknown: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

unlock.title: One more step
unlock.subtitle: This device doesn't have the key to your shared history yet.
unlock.hint: Open this app on the device that already works, go to Settings, and approve this one. Check that the code below is the one it shows you.
unlock.noPartnerYet: No other device has appeared yet.
unlock.mismatchHelp: Nothing has been shared yet, so there's nothing to undo. Get a new code below and compare again. If it still doesn't match, stop — someone may be sitting between the two of you.
unlock.reset: Get a new code for this device

approve.title: Let a device in
approve.subtitle: Approving gives it access to everything the two of you have written.
approve.compare: Both screens should show these same characters. Read them aloud to each other.
approve.action: The codes match — let it in
approve.mismatch: If the codes are different, don't approve — use the button above instead.
approve.mismatchHelp: Nothing was shared, and nothing needs undoing. On the other device, choose "the codes don't match" and then "get a new code", and compare again.

error.key_changed: That device changed while you were comparing. Start again and check the new code.
error.gone: That device is no longer waiting.
